name: id
description: The ID of the pagination container.

name: items
description: The items within the pagination component.

params.name: number
params.description: The pagination item text – usually a page number.  Required unless the item is an ellipsis.

params.name: visuallyHiddenText
params.description: The visually hidden label for the pagination item, which will be applied to an `aria-label` and announced by screen readers on the pagination item link. Should include page number. Defaults to, for example "Page 1". Replaced by the `item.ariaLabel` option.

params.name: ariaLabel
params.description: The accessible name for the pagination item, which will be applied to an `aria-label` and announced by screen readers on the pagination item link. Should include page number. Defaults to, for example "Page 1".

params.name: href
params.description: The pagination item `href` attribute. Required unless the item is an ellipsis.

params.name: current
params.description: Set to `true` to indicate the current page the user is on.

params.name: ellipsis
params.description: Use this option if you want to specify an ellipsis at a given point between numbers. If you set this option as `true`, any other options for the item are ignored.

params.name: attributes
params.description: The HTML attributes (for example, data attributes) you want to add to the link.

name: previous
description: A link to the previous page, if there is a previous page.

params.name: text
params.description: The text content of the link to the previous page. Defaults to `"Previous page"`, with 'page' being visually hidden. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content of the link to the previous page. Defaults to `"Previous page"`, with 'page' being visually hidden. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: labelText
params.description: Replaced by the `previous.label.text` option.

params.name: label
params.description: The optional label that goes underneath the link to the previous page, providing further context for the user about where the link goes.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: href
params.description: The previous page's URL.

params.name: attributes
params.description: The HTML attributes (for example, data attributes) you want to add to the link.

name: next
description: A link to the next page, if there is a next page.

params.name: text
params.description: The text content of the link to the next page. Defaults to `"Next page"`, with 'page' being visually hidden. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: The HTML content of the link to the next page. Defaults to `"Next page"`, with 'page' being visually hidden. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: labelText
params.description: Replaced by the `next.label.text` option.

params.name: label
params.description: The optional label that goes underneath the link to the next page, providing further context for the user about where the link goes.

params.name: text
params.description: If `html` is set, this is not required. Text to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: html
params.description: If `text` is set, this is not required. HTML to use within the label. If `html` is provided, the `text` option will be ignored.

params.name: href
params.description: The next page's URL.

params.name: attributes
params.description: The HTML attributes (for example, data attributes) you want to add to the link.

name: ariaLabel
description: The accessible name for the navigation landmark that wraps the pagination. Defaults to `"Pagination"`.

name: classes
description: The classes you want to add to the pagination `nav` parent.

name: attributes
description: The HTML attributes (for example, data attributes) you want to add to the pagination `nav` parent.
